translated_text: My Love, the 15th. V.40 I had lunch today at Josephine Baker's magnificent villa near Paris. I was supposed to do a story, but she was too sad; she didn't want to see me. My poor Bobchen, you've had a fever and you're not receiving my letters. I'm writing to you every day now; everything is fine between us. I've already written to your friend at the Censorship Office. He's surely received it by now. Don't send me any money. I've already told you I have enough for now, and the State has promised to pay me soon. I've already sent you the Ilford bill. Cash the money, but don't keep it; I'll send it back to you. If so, I... You mustn't be without money, but be careful so it doesn't get stolen. Goodbye my darling Bobchen, I adore you and I can't stop thinking about you while holding you very, very tightly in my arms - Baba. I think the baby moved for the first time today. Military Postal Control PARIS 7 PM MAY 40 RUE DES CAPUCINES The Postmaster VOJENSKA CENSURA
